notes.title: Update v0.0.92.101 now live on all branches
notes.content:
Hello Survivors, i know it has been a while since our last update note but we finally got an update out.
To save us time since we are only a small group, the list you see below includes also currently for you players not visible changes since they were made for the new mode we are still working on. But we still hope the bug fixes and QoL improvements.


 Finished Random Generator for bunker System
 Make lights flicker random
 add muzzle flash to weapons
 remove decoration zombie and move logic into a controller
 add senses for the bunker zombies
 Fixed bunker generation issue which lead to not traversable bunker layout
 Moved logic of decoration zombie into a decoration controller so a seperated actor is not needed anymore.
 add muzze flash light when shooting
 Added perception systems to a controller to get zombies ready for the bunker release
 Change bunker lights from spot to point light for a more realistic look
 Change size of tunnels
 Changed lights of the cafeteria to point lights
 Set default bullet speed for M1911 so it works in Containment breach
 Adjustes brightness off flashlight attachment
 Add npcs to the bunker
 Expand generation script first connect closes room and so on the achieve a more realistic bunker layout.
 Changed switch component to be interactable
 Added light switch to sleepm room
 After hiding the hud and reenabling it the mouse coursor is missing
 Added first version of muzzle flash
 Replaced ak47 shoot sound
 Add  missing back buttons in ui
 Move all the logic for video settings into the widget :) and use GameUserSettings for the most part
 Fixed garbage collection of slider styles
 Fix muzzle flash looping
 Changed interact line trace to be fired every 0.2 sec and to be hopefully async to the main thread
 Add function to get Text for interactable actors / components (Returns an SWidget to define more advanced styling).
 Fixed slider an numeric entry box where not connected
 Fix delegate exception for numeric entry box


Let us know what you think of the update and as always thanks for playing.

To get the latest news consider joining us on discord or follow us on twitter.
Discord: http://discord.gg/3Vr5gxr
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BGP_Productions

With kind regards
Developer Team

notes.title: Update v0.0.90,108 Monthly Update Audio Settings

Its again time for a monthly update sadly the update is not as big as i had hoped for well atleast from the content standpoint. 

In the background we upgraded the engine to ue4.25.3 from ue4.23.1.

But now to the stuff that affects the game we now have our new ui inplace for the audio settings and extended the functionality there so now you can adjust the the ambient sound volume, the zombies sounds, the round begin sound volume and you also got a master volume setting which defines the overall volume.

We also added the hide HUD functionality to the main menu so you can walk around again and enjoy your camp sanctuary which gets build by leveling up.

So as you can see not that many things have changed but we hope that next month we can get a little more exiting stuff out and maybe fix this crashing bug in the main menu.

Also currently you can't bring the menu back when you hide it we will get a fix for that out soon as well for the esc menu in the game where if you press back you will get to the normal menu and can't resume the game.

Hope you all enjoy the update and as always thanks for playing Space Survivors Shooter.

notes.title: v0.0.90,60 New UI Element / Switching to monthly updates / Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

As stated in the title we are now switching from weekly updates to monthly updates, this decison was not made lightheaded, but since we couldn't provide updates that frequently over a long period of time, we didn't saw any reason to hang on to that rythm. So from now on we will update the default branch of the game at the begining of each month. 

The other branches are not effected an will get updates from us when we feel like it but you will be notified via patch notes.

Now let's get to the one change that is in the update.
We added a score board / info board / stat board however you wann a call it. It appears if the key is pressed and dissapears if the key is released.

This little board took us very long to make since we hade some major problems understanding the c++ code needed for it, thats also why nothing else is finished for that update but now let's get to the fun part talking about what lies ahead road to v0.1.0:

 
 Completing the info board currently not everything we want to show is in there and also the design needs some tweaks.
 Create revive functionality / Bleed out
 Shader / texture improvements
 Finish first deck on the W.I.P Map
 Add M60E3
 Add G36C
 Add AK-47
 Add Barett M82
 Add Mossberg 500
 New Zombie Sounds
 First attachment (flashlight)


So as you can see mainly new weapons are coming and new textures. Of course bug fixing is also stated there but since we don't have any breaking bugs that we are aware off they don't have the highest priority.

We hope you all enjoy the little update and as always thanks for playing Space Survivors Shooter.

With kind regards
Developer Team

notes.title: Update v0.0.90 Soon in the latest_experimental branch
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,
I know it has been a while since our last update of our game but no it isn't dead, in the last months my team and me worked very hard on the new v0.0.90 update which will be the biggest update our game has seen yet. As we still have some things to do the main core functionality is nearly ready to be released. We aim to get the version out on the Latest Experimental branch to the end of may.

Hi Survivors,
I know it has been a while since our last update of our game but no it isn't dead in the last months my team and I worked very hard on the new v0.0.90 update, which will be the biggest update our game has seen yet. As we still have some things to do, the main core functionality is nearly ready to be released. We aim to get the version out on the Latest Experimental branch to the end of May.

Most of the stuff the update brings, are enhancements in the background but also many new features and some bugfixes.

So here is a shortlist of none background stuff:

 3-4 new Weapons (Desert Eagle, Honey Badger, SCAR-H and a Shotgun maybe)
 A new Zombie map yes you heard correctly we will swap out the old zity map for a new one which will get updates, new area updates after the update is released to increase the playable area.
 A new character model after many tries and some well better-looking characters we decided to give up on making our own character and used one created by make Humans for the player.
 New zombie model, here we are using one from mixamo with one animation also from the same platform, but I think we will replace the animations soon with our own one.
 New Player animations, we finally added our own new walk animation as well as aiming animation to the character.
 Leveling system yeah you read correctly we now have a basic leveling system in place which grants 5xp for every zombie hit and each level you reach will change the look your main menu. This system is just the first stage of what we would like to integrate into the game.
 New Settings, we now added a zombie sound slider to the game,
which lets you control the volume of the zombies sound also the settings menu is now accessible via the esc menu while playing.
 New looking materials, we updated our shaders to be better looking I think you will notice
 Hair and clothing for the character
 Max ammo powerup
 Now we also added  the weapons name under the price, so you see exactly which weapon you are buying since we got 3 different desert eagles inside (.357, .44, .50)


So I think I still forgot some stuff to write above since we have done so many things.

Hope you all enjoy the update and have fun.

With kind regards
The Developer Team

notes.title: Update v0.0.83,0 (Pretesting)
notes.content:
Hi,

As some of you may have notice we rolled out an update for Pretesting.
Here are the patch notes for it:

Integrated steam for joining via the steam friends menu.
Added a parameter into the gamemode.xml for defining if players respawn at the end of a wave or at the start of the next one.

What that means is you don't have to do port forwarding and tell your friends your ip address because now when you press host a session will be created in which people can join through a steam invite or via pressing right click and then select join lobby. 

We still got some bugs so you can't join if you don't have the game open already and other people can only join via the host. Also the lobbies are limited to 4 Players right now but that will be changeable in the future in the multiplayer section.

 Hope all of you enjoy the update and as always thanks for playing Space Survivors Shooter.

With kind regards

SevenOperation

notes.title: Space Survivors Shooter Update v0.0.80
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

Today i am happy to announce that we have completed all things for the version 0.0.80 which is a huge milestone for us.

What does that mean for you?

Well of course that dosen't mean we now stop developing the game further but it means that we have reached for our standard a solid foundation to grow our game. So you can expect that a lot more is coming and that the currently systems in place get polished of course.

What were the requirements to get to v0.0.80?

Well thats very simple for me personally, it was not about the graphics just to be clear. It was more about the functionality we wanted to have in our game, such as a river (Well thats basicly graphics), shooting, buying ways, drop and take weapons, a switch for electricity that also change the daylight, running, zombie pathfinding and much more but i think you all get it. So and the last requirement we wanted to archive was that we have a basic aiming system without relaying on animations. For the graphic changes you might have noticed over time (landscape and so on) Gx1|Dolobarsch was responsible while Gx1|Borderfield did some textures too and made all curently hearable sounds in our game. 

What can be expected from the v0.0.80 onwards?

We now have started to work on the v0.0.90 which includes things like more animations, new 3d models, more perks, more maps and so one, and maybe also a little surprise. But mainly we will focus about enhancing our systems as an example adding ui to control volume in game, changeing game parameters in a ui (currently only possible via xml editing) and of course we will add new textures.

So yeah thats basicly it i hope you have fun playing our game. If you find any bugs please report them in the bugs discussion channel.

And as always thanks for playing Space Survivors Shooter

Kind regards 

SevenOperation

notes.title: Update / bug fix v0.0.69
notes.content:
Hi testers,

This is a small / large update, here are the change notes:

1. No start weapon at the beginig any more, so don't forget to take the free weapon at the start , before trying to shoot some Zombies (puppets).
2. Now you can not have a weapon twice anymore.
3. New HUD Configuration your money is now located at the left side while your health is at the bottom right.
4. Also the ammo shows now the bullets in the magazine and the bullets left for reloading instead of max magazine capacity.
5.  The weapon location has also moved to the right.

Thats it hope you are all enjoying this update , so see you on the next update hopefully next Sunday.

And as always thanks for playing Space Survivors Shooter.
